answer: The network assigns each agent a cryptographic stake anchored to a unique hardware attestation; when a new node joins, its recruiter must broadcast a signed referral that creates a basalt‑hard, dune‑shaped proof of linkage. The system then issues a time‑locked ripple of reward tokens that decay to zero if the referral graph shows a cycle or excessive depth, effectively paying nothing for sybil‑spawned recruits.
